text:
Laura N: New hire Priy starts Mon remote (WA). Background check returned SSN mismatch + vendor asking for a recent paystub. She said she changed banks recently.
Ben Y: Okay send Checkr screenshot and candidate confirmation. We can ask vendor to re-run with updated info. Also check for multiple last names on records.
Aria K: I can call Priy to confirm bank details. Also flag: she only has a state learner permit, not a full license. For I-9 she can present passport (List A) or a combination of DL+SSN card.
Laura N: She prefers not to travel. Asked if notary is acceptable for Section 2.
Felix D: Notary is acceptable. Candidate signs Section 1, notary completes Section 2 using our Authorized Rep template, include notary commission info. We reimburse up to $40. If she uses notary, upload signed rep form + scan of Section 2 to secure folder.
Ben Y: Ops note: if laptop ships mark "Hold for ID". IT can ship with tracking and signature. If vendor still shows SSN mismatch after paystub, payroll may need manual override to avoid payroll delay.
Aria K: Reached Priy. She booked an appointment at a bank notary Tues 2pm. Sent her the rep form and the reimbursement link. Also asked for a recent paystub; she said she'll upload it to Checkr.
OnboardBot: Reminder: required items before Day 1: I-9, W-4, Direct Deposit, Emergency Contact, NDA. Template links: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/forms. Auto-reminder set 48h before start.
Laura N: One more: security wants a copy of rep form in case they audit. Felix, can you confirm retention window?
Felix D: Keep signed docs in /secure/hr/onboarding for 3 years per retention policy. Upload within 24h of completion.
Ben Y: I'll add a temporary network account so Priy can do benefits orientation on Day 1 even if badge delayed. Full access only after ID confirmed and Checkr cleared.
Aria K: Update 15:10: Priy uploaded paystub and notary receipt. I forwarded to Checkr and to payroll.
Laura N: Update 17:45: Checkr marked "review required" then cleared at 18:20 after paystub. Notary-signed Section 2 uploaded, rep form complete. IT shipped laptop with "Hold for ID" and ops released after upload. W-4 + DD completed by candidate. Closing loop ":white_check_mark:"
